item.title: Iranian drone strike sets U.S. consulate in Dubai ablaze
item.description: ALBAWABA- An Iranian drone struck the U.S. Consulate in Dubai on Tuesday evening, igniting a fire and marking the second attack on an American diplomatic mission in the Gulf in a day. The incident follows a similar strike on the U.S. Embassy in Riyadh, underscoring the rising tensions across the region.Witnesses reported flames and thick smoke rising from the area around the consulate in Dubai’s Al Satwa district, prompting evacuations and a swift security response.
